title: Performable Music / 可表演音乐
summary: 连接创作意图、Ableton 编曲与实时演出的音乐研究。Agent 协助生成草稿、管理结构与排练，人的选择和演奏保留在系统中心。
summaryEn: A research programme joining authored score intentions, Ableton-based composition and realtime performance. Agents support drafts, mapping and documentation rather than replacing the performer.
